name: Trade Delivery 1
definition: Specifies how the supply chain shipping arrangements and the delivery of products and/or services as well as related documentation.

DeliveryPeriod.name: Delivery Period
DeliveryPeriod.definition: Actual delivery period of the products and/or services.

DeliveryDateTime.name: Delivery Date Time
DeliveryDateTime.definition: Actual delivery date/time of the products and/or services.

ShipFrom.name: Ship From
ShipFrom.definition: Party from whom the goods are dispatched.

ShipTo.name: Ship To
ShipTo.definition: Party to whom the goods are dispatched.

UltimateShipTo.name: Ultimate Ship To
UltimateShipTo.definition: Final party to whom the goods are dispatched.

DeliveryNote.name: Delivery Note
DeliveryNote.definition: Delivery note related to the delivery of the products and/or services.

Consignment.name: Consignment
Consignment.definition: Physical consolidation of goods for transport.
